source_evidence: src/win.cpp Win::hide now tests JackalInitFlags as an integer value and represents focus_a/focus_b/chosen and the root traversal target as Win pointers. Its existing read order, nullable branches, callback-dependent count/target reloads and val_4_ conversion remain intact. No global/class layout or unrelated method was changed.

recovery/tests/win_hide_harness.cpp obtains the actual source body through the existing compiler/Wine harness. Direct flag values, a readable even-address/odd-pointee negative control, owner cleanup and mutable root traversal cover this bounded defect; test_control_globals.py deliberately restores the old indirection only in a private test body. These doubles do not establish application layout, actual virtual dispatch or game acceptance.

The source bug and local pointer representation are incorporated. The original unclaimed mapping is retained; further instruction matching, callee/global binding and surrounding Win lifetime/storage recovery remain open. Incoming BaseButton coordination and all other pending findings are unchanged.
